L.scope: Recorded finite-output-interval energy change minus trapezoidal endpoint native production; not exact Runge-Kutta stage closure or pure dissipation.

E.scope: Recorded finite-output-interval energy change minus trapezoidal endpoint native production; not exact Runge-Kutta stage closure or pure dissipation.

anomaly.scope: Recorded finite-output-interval energy change minus trapezoidal endpoint native production; not exact Runge-Kutta stage closure or pure dissipation.

mean_momentum_budget.scope: Depth-weighted comparison of actual mean-profile changes with trapezoidal native total tendency at the saved profile times. Profile intervals can be longer than the energy-diagnostic intervals. Residual includes temporal quadrature error; it is not repaired or labelled pure dissipation.

definitions.jet_anomaly: Energy of the raw change in the horizontally averaged current from its own initial profile, including any uniform momentum drift; distinct from energy already present in the imposed shear. The cosine-shape diagnostic separately removes depth-mean change.
definitions.ky0_eddy_fraction: Eky0_eddy/Eeddy, with horizontally uniform mean energy removed from both numerator and denominator. Full Eky0 and Ehorizontal_mean remain separate.
definitions.native_3d: Native advection of the full field minus native advection evaluated on the replicated y mean; scheme-dependent, not identical to a continuum Reynolds covariance.
definitions.jet_spacing: Cosine least-squares diagnostic of the changed depth profile on the bounded vertical interval. 2H/n is a descriptive wavelength, not a periodic-box spectrum or an eigenmode prediction.
definitions.closure: Native sampled endpoint tendencies, including the actual closure term; any mismatch remains reported. No post-hoc term repairs the budget.
definitions.pressure: The horizontal mean of the native gradient of the last projection pressure is a periodicity check; it vanishes for any periodic pressure and is not an instantaneous pointwise pressure solve.
definitions.threshold_crossings: Descriptive times when changed mean-profile energy exceeds 1%, 5% or 10% of initial eddy energy for three outputs. These conventions do not define a universal jet-onset criterion.
definitions.sampled_production_integrals: Trapezoidal integrals of the recorded signed and absolute endpoint native productions. They are not exact Runge-Kutta stage integrals.

limits: A single realization is not an ensemble significance test.
A larger native 3D term does not by itself identify a competing jet mechanism.
Small-scale vorticity residuals and signed jet-energy supply answer different questions.
Temporal output quadrature and model time-step convergence require separate checks.

robustness_comparisons.scope: Paired final-time changes at identical grid, physical mean, wave field, in-plane base realization and maximum timestep. Each seed is reported separately; no significance claim. Added transverse perturbation energy is retained in the metadata.

numerical_checks.scope: Descriptive paired final-time, native-budget and recorded-timestep checks. A resolution run may also change the timestep; long-time trajectory differences in a single chaotic realization are not a statistical convergence proof.

scope: Controlled nonlinear robustness, native jet-energy budgets and signed weak-mode responses. Results appear only after each required run has a completion record; this report does not submit or modify simulations.
